apis.title: Creator management
apis.description: Create and manage your Summer Games store games: store page drafts, revisions, preview links, media, builds and releases, and the owner approval that publishes them.
apis.auth: Your Summer account token. An agent gets it by signing in with OAuth: `summer login --store` in the Summer CLI, or the Summer connector in an AI app. Agent tokens can call only the operations on these pages. Publishing needs an approval from the game's owner first.

apis.title: Analytics
apis.description: Read your game's analytics: the activity overview and the catalog of events your game sends.
apis.auth: Your Summer account token, the same one the creator management API uses (`summer login --store`). You can read only games you own or manage.

apis.title: Store and account
apis.description: Public Summer Games store reads, the connected-app OAuth endpoints, and the signed-in player's profile and preferences.
apis.auth: A player access token. Store reads need no token. Other apps get a token through connected-app OAuth: register the client, let the player approve it on summer.games, then exchange the code at the token endpoint.
